timeline.summary: Vertical edit opens with a WeChat handle and the editorial title '搭讪被拒绝怎么办？' over identifiable public-street footage; no transcript speech is present.

A man in a black ESSENTIALS shirt approaches a grey-top woman and says he wants to meet her. The woman keeps moving; by the end of this interval he turns toward a nearby two-woman group. The ASR does not reliably capture the first woman's reply, so her exact words remain unknown.

The man introduces himself as Mike, asks where one woman is going and asks to leave WeChat before she goes. A worker or passerby with a cart enters the scene. Speaker turns and the scope of any assent are not reliably diarized.

The conversation continues about whether the woman is local, then includes an appearance-based comment that she is cute and 'small'. The two stand near the group while the man appears to handle a phone; the screen and any saved contact are not visible.

They discuss that she is visiting and will leave the next day. The man mentions a possible future meeting if she returns to Chengdu, followed by '拜拜'. The edit ends without showing a verified saved contact, publication consent or later outcome.
